claim: You can switch between an AWS owned key, an AWS managed key and a customer managed key up to four times per 24-hour window per table. If there was no change in the past six hours, an additional change is allowed, for a maximum of eight changes in a day.

qualifiers.condition: switching to an AWS owned key is allowed as often as necessary

evidence.quote: You can switch between an AWS owned key, an AWS managed key, and a customer managed key up to four times, anytime per 24-hour window, on a per table basis, starting from when the table was created. If there was no change in the past six hours, an additional change is allowed. This effectively brings the maximum number of changes in a day to eight (four changes in the first six hours, and one change for each of the subsequent six hour windows in a day).
